description: This file implements functions for escaping JSON strings, including handling Unicode characters, ASCII characters, and special code points. It provides utilities for converting strings into JSON-compatible escaped formats.

methods.name: EscapeJSONString
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output, handling Unicode and ASCII characters, with optional quotes.

methods.name: EscapeBytesAsInvalidJSONString
methods.description: Escapes a byte string as an invalid JSON string, handling non-printable characters.
